rationale: tools/build-skia.sh, the desktop Skia source-build fallback, now builds the exact manifest skia_commit through skia-builder -revision instead of comparing a moving milestone branch head, and verifies the built Skia and synced Dawn HEADs against skia_commit and built_dawn before copying output. The pinned release assets, their digests, the provider fetch path, and every render backend are unchanged; this only makes the fallback reproduce the already-pinned provider. No design-import, Chromium, rendering, or packaging authority moves.
